name: RC-B10-0438/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Azerbaijan for holding opposition politicians and others it calls political prisoners, including Ali Karimli and Anar Mammadli. It asks for their release, better prison conditions and fair trials. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions, to watch trials, and to make any future partnership deal with Azerbaijan depend on human rights improvements.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and asks for action.
- It concerns Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli, Anar Abdullayev and over 300 other prisoners in Azerbaijan.
- Next, the resolution goes to EU governments, the Commission and Azerbaijan's authorities; they decide whether to act.
